text_block_list.text:
One day, Gold Ship came to the Trainer's 
Office, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. It is quite a lovely day 
today, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter, to make you look so 
surprised?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You seem a little off today, Trainer. Are 
you feeling alright?
choice_data_list: Has anything unusual happened to you too?
Has anything changed for you too?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Umm... if I had to say, it would only be 
that I've been troubled by a headache.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Speak of the devil, the pain is coming 
baaack—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaah! Man, give me a break already!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? Throughout heaven and earth, Golshi 
alone is the honored one! Obviously 
there's only one Golshi-chan!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Yelling made my head start 
hurting again...

Gold Ship seems to be troubled by a 
headache.
